description: This file defines the HTMLActuator class responsible for updating the game UI elements in a 2048 game implementation, including rendering tiles, updating scores, and displaying messages.

classes.name: HTMLActuator
classes.description: Class responsible for updating the game display, including tiles, scores, and messages.

methods.name: actuate
methods.description: Updates the game display based on the current grid and game metadata.

methods.name: continueGame
methods.description: Clears game messages to continue or restart the game.

methods.name: clearContainer
methods.description: Removes all child elements from a given container.

methods.name: addTile
methods.description: Creates and adds a tile element to the game board.

methods.name: applyClasses
methods.description: Sets the class attribute of an element based on a list of classes.

methods.name: normalizePosition
methods.description: Converts a position to a normalized form for CSS class naming.

methods.name: positionClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class name for a tile's position.

methods.name: updateScore
methods.description: Updates the score display and shows score increments.

methods.name: updateBestScore
methods.description: Updates the display of the best score.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Displays a win or game over message.

methods.name: clearMessage
methods.description: Removes game over or win messages from the display.
